description: This PHP script is part of the vtiger CRM project, specifically handling the display of audit trail data within the Settings module. It retrieves audit records for a specified user and displays them with pagination, using Smarty templates for rendering.

classes.name: AuditTrail
classes.description: A class responsible for providing audit trail header and entries data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty template engine for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getAuditTrailHeader
methods.description: Returns header information for audit trail display.

methods.name: getAuditTrailEntries
methods.description: Retrieves audit trail entries for a given user, with pagination support.
